title: A failed map tile is treated as known, so it is never requested again for that view
trigger: getMapThumbnailFile errors (TileState::Failed via file_answered(extra, None)); tile_to_request() only checks that the key exists in self.tiles
effect: The map stays blank at that view with no error or retry until the user pans or zooms to a different key
fix: Treat Failed as not loaded (drop it, with a backoff) or show a retry

title: Admin delete box fires the moderation plan and drops its error, then deletes the message anyway
trigger: In the admin delete box tick Ban or Report spam and confirm while the connection is down (or a send fails on step 2 of the plan); selection_mode.rs calls `let _ = live.driver.moderate_message(..)` and then confirm_delete
effect: The message is deleted but the report, delete-all or ban was never sent (or only the first steps were) with no error and the box closed; retrying repeats the steps already sent
fix: a Moderation stage per box holding the plan and the RequestId of the step out; the delete waits for it and an error gives the box back

title: An opener thread that ends leaves its decoded clips Opening forever
trigger: A video sticker (WebM) is decoding on an opener thread and the decode closure panics (spawn_guarded catches it and the thread exits), or every opener thread has ended
effect: The sticker never gets a first frame; its UiClip stays Opening::Pending, and views waiting on the first frame keep animating (ticking) with no way out until the clip goes stale and is closed. WorkerEnd(.., None) only sets worker_gone and never fails clips in Stage::Opening, nor Stage::Waiting(Origin::Decoded) once no opener runs (workers_decode stays false)
fix: Track opener threads as WorkerLife too; when an opener ends, fail the clip it held (Stage::Opening for Decoded) and when none run, fail Waiting(Decoded) clips or flip workers_decode; drop worker_gone for the per-thread lives

title: AiAsk::Asked is matched by composer markup, and the AI answer slots carry no RequestId; the send's RequestId is dropped
trigger: Press Fix, then Rewrite on the same draft before the first answer lands (send_ai_compose does not refuse while AiAsk::Asked). Both asks store Asked{markup} and both answers match it.
effect: The first answer is applied as if it were the second ask's; the second answer then finds AiAsk::Idle and shows 'the draft changed, AI answer ignored' although nothing was typed. If both answers arrive within one frame the single Option slot (ai_composer_text / ai_composer_blocks) is overwritten and one is lost. A failed ask leaves Asked set for good, so a late answer for an old ask applies whenever the field holds the same markup again.
fix: AiAsk::Asked { request: RequestId, markup } (as SentText::Sent does), the answer carries its RequestId and applies only when it equals the held one; an error answer returns the stage to Idle

title: A background client that dies or fails is never started again until the user switches, connects or unlocks
trigger: A signed-in background account's TDLib client stops (bridge.stopped_unexpectedly, or a start fails with Failed); poll_background takes its live and pushes it to closing with restart=false
effect: That account stops notifying and counting unread until the next connect, switch, unlock or disk resume (the only callers of ensure_background_accounts); nothing re-runs the pass on a timer, so the retryable() path is unreachable while the user stays on one account
fix: push_closing(..., restart: matches!(status, Failed)) with a backoff clock, or an ensure pass scheduled by the poll when any client is retryable()

title: close_call_layers_for_lock does not close the invite or share box (call_box) or the stream key box state it hides only by not drawing
trigger: Open Share Invite Link (or a stream window's share box), lock, unlock
effect: Box comes back after unlock instead of staying closed; while locked it is undrawn but share_open() still makes stream_key_down swallow M/F/Esc keys
fix: close_call_box in the lock closer, or one window-box enum

title: begin_topic_editor overwrites a Sending TopicEditor with a fresh Submit::default()
trigger: Open the topic editor, press Save (Sending), then pick Edit Topic from the topic context menu / header New Topic for the same forum (open_forum_topic_editor -> begin_topic_editor)
effect: the in-flight createForumTopic/editForumTopic request is dropped from the stage; its answer (and refusal reason) is never shown and the user can submit a duplicate topic
fix: begin_topic_editor refuses (or keeps the editor) while editor.submit is Sending; or hold the Submit in an enum Editor { Closed, Open(TopicEditor) } whose transitions check Sending

title: Decode::Decoding names a running job but the job and its future are detached, so a replaced decode keeps running
trigger: Open an HDR picture in the viewer and step quickly through several (each step reset()s to Idle and render starts a new decode), or zoom across an EDGE_STEP bucket
effect: each superseded decode keeps running to the end on the background pool (HDR JPEG XL up to 1 GB and a full-size float copy each on Windows); only its answer is dropped by key. Concurrent big decodes pile up
fix: hold the Task in Decode::Decoding { key, showing, task } so reset() or a new key cancels the old decode

title: Reorient::Decoding keeps a token and the decode Task is detach()ed, so a superseded turn still decodes a full-size picture (contradicts section 8 11-p1-005 'a newer press, a step or a close drops the decode, so no generation counter')
trigger: Open a large photo, press Rotate three times quickly (or Rotate, then step to the next item or close the viewer)
effect: Each press starts its own background_spawn decode (up to ~20 MB and a GPU upload each) that runs to the end; only the late result is ignored by token (finish_viewer_reorient). Wasted CPU/memory, and a token counter the docs say was removed
fix: Hold the awaiting Task (which owns the background job) inside Reorient::Decoding so begin/cancel/reset drop it; drop the token and the is_decoding(token) match

title: A reply typed into Quill's own notification window is lost when the send is refused
trigger: Own notification windows are on. Open the Reply field in a toast of a channel or a chat you cannot write in, type text, press Enter.
effect: The window closes and the chat opens with an empty composer; the typed text is gone, though InlineReplyOutcome::Refused documents that it must not vanish. The platform path keeps it in delivery.unsent_replies (inline_reply.rs:172), the ViewEvent::ReplySent arm never does.
fix: One path for a typed reply: ReplySent hands the text to send_typed_notification_reply's store (or the ChatClick carries the text) so any outcome other than Sent keeps it

title: ShowStage::Saving(RequestId) never compares its request; the box settles on the privacy key's state
trigger: Tap Show My Last Seen while another save of the Last seen rule (or an older SaveFailed) is in the key state.
effect: drain_show_or_premium matches `Saving(_)` and then reads `settings.privacy[ShowStatus]` / `read_date`: an unrelated save's refusal toasts 'failed' for this request, and Ready from an older answer toasts 'shown' before this request is answered. The id held in the stage is dead data.
fix: Settle on the RequestId in the stage (answer/error for that request), as profile saves do with SaveWatch

title: A picked still sticker whose download cannot be sent waits in PickWait::Downloading with no way out
trigger: Adapt from a Sticker: pick a not-yet-downloaded WebP sticker while the connection path is down (download_file returns Err and unsticks its record)
effect: No editor opens and no note is shown; the pick is dropped silently only when the box is closed. The WebM path (video_pick.rs:77) handles the same Err with a note; the still path ignores it with `let _ =`, and sticker_box_window_upkeep leaves the wait only on ended_without_file, which needs a download record that an unsent request does not have
fix: Check the send result before entering Downloading (as pick_video_for_set does), or share one helper for both paths

title: A second pinned-chat drop while the first SetPinnedChats is in flight leaves Order::Reordering for good
trigger: Drag a pinned chat to a new slot, then drag another one before the server answers the first. touch_bar_reorder gets Ok(None) from set_pinned_chat_order (a SetPinnedChats is pending, so nothing is sent or applied) and never calls reorder_refused.
effect: The panel keeps the second order on screen while the model holds the first (reorder_echo stays Waiting: same pins, different order). It looks saved but is not, until the pinned list changes.
fix: Make the drop's outcome one value: touch_bar_reorder maps Ok(None)/Err to reorder_refused, or Reordering carries the RequestId and is left when it settles

title: set_volume sets want_audio before reopening and never undoes it when Player::open fails
trigger: Open a clip muted (volume 0), then turn the volume up while the reopen fails (file locked/moved, decoder open error)
effect: The clip stays silent for good: want_audio is already true so the reopen is never retried, and the old silent player and sound=None are kept
fix: Make 'sound requested' part of the reopen result (set want_audio only after Player::open succeeds), or a stage enum Muted/Reopening/Audible

title: Failed translation counts as done: the pump never asks again (needs_translation is is_none)
trigger: Open a translated chat while offline or with a send that fails (abandon_translation, 'send'), or a TDLib error answer; go back online
effect: The message stays in the original for the rest of the session (until edit or history prune); no retry, though translate_message says 'a failed one is asked for again'
fix: Fetch-like stage with retry rule: Failed(at) retried after a backoff or on chat reopen; pump asks for Idle only
